headline_seed: Live updates: D.C. gunman fixated on grievances with condo association, people who knew him say - The Washington Post
draft_text:
#BreakingMews One killed, four shot at a DC gym near Logan Circle this morning. The gunman barricaded himself in an apartment building and died of a self-inflicted wound after roughly an hour of negotiations. CNN and CBS News confirm.

And that's the mews.
